name: r62_manual_robu
title: Manual readability (black code blocks fixed) + system mindmap & process-flow diagrams + Robu manual-map mastery
intro: R62 (2026-10-16): the user reported the technical manual full of blank 'black screen' screenshots and asked for a mindmap/process-flow diagram; a real Robu chat showed vague manual queries answered with cover-page dumps (incl. personal contact details) and 'Full NDLI Club Management manual' answered with live club counts. Root cause of the black boxes: `code { color: #0F172A }` beat the inherited `pre { color: #E2E8F0 }` inside `pre { background: #0B151F }`, so code text was dark-on-dark and invisible (they were code blocks, not screenshots). This round: (A1) the pre-code colour fix; (A2) two new front-matter pages with hand-authored SVG diagrams -- System Overview & End-to-End Process Flow + System Mindmap & Manual Map (chapter map table); (A3) honest pagination -- every 'Page X of N' label and TOC row agrees with the page that carries the chapter (this also caught a pre-existing ch.11 TOC typo), and the Technical Reference PDF is rebuilt with WeasyPrint at exactly 32 physical pages, every label landing on its own page; (B1) both cover pages are wrapped in KB-EXCLUDE markers so author contact details are never retrievable; (B2) the overview pages are the retrieval anchor for process/architecture questions; (B3/B4) bare manual requests and pasted manual URLs route to a deterministic orientation answer BEFORE the club-data intents ('manual entry' stays an app feature); (B5) the three real chat failures are permanent golden-question regressions (21/21 evals). Pin-follow (R57 precedent): test_r58_retrieval's golden-coverage pin evolved so manual_map goldens assert their keywords on the composer answer the user actually receives.
markers: code blocks readable (pre code colour fix)
technical cover excluded from the KB

commit_message: R62: manual black-code-blocks fixed + system mindmap & process-flow diagrams + Robu manual-map routing (cover dumps and club-count steals fixed)
